|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Rallying Cry''' is a [[warcry]] [[skill]] that [[taunt]]s nearby enemies, grants nearby [[Ally|allies]] an added damage [[buff]] based on the user's main hand weapon and [[power]] of nearby enemies and allies, and [[exert]]s a number of subsequent [[attack]]s to deal more damage based on the number of allies buffed by the warcry. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Power''': {{c|help|Normal Monsters have 1 Power, Magic Monsters 2, Rare Monsters 10, Unique Monsters 20, and Players 5}} * Because non-blocking entities are not found by effects that search for nearby targets,https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/e7hg0u/ggg_can_we_have_skitterbots_count_as_minioms_for/fa0ym6f/ {{il|Summon Skitterbots}} minions do not contribute power, and cannot be buffed. Undamageable entities are not necessarily non-blocking; Rallying Cry does find e.g. [[mirage_(proxy)|mirages]] and {{il|Holy Strike}} minions.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TwBfboopWEQ {{c|mod|more Damage per affected Ally}}: This modifier counts the number of allies buffed by the warcry. It does not require allies to stay buffed or stay alive afterward; the damage bonus will apply to exerted attacks regardless.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tK6BRBExltc Using Rallying Cry again will record a new number of buffed allies, even if the player had exerts remaining with a greater damage bonus. If the skill cannot apply buffs due to {{il|Autoexertion}}, the number of affected allies will be 0, and exerted attacks will not receive a damage multiplier.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3535514#p25374811 '''[[Buff]]:''' Multiple Rallying Cry buffs can be granted to allies, but only the strongest one will be active. Each instance has an independent [[duration]]. Weapon swapping immediately removes the Rallying Cry buff from allies. '''[[Proxies]]:''' Because proxies like [[totems]] and [[Mirage (proxy)|mirage]]s use the player's skill, which has the player's stats and not their own, their damage cannot be buffed by Rallying Cry. They do count as affected allies for the exerted attack damage bonus, however. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Warcry

It has a base duration of 2.5 seconds at gem level 1 (previously 5), scaling up to 3.4 at gem level 20 (previously 5.9). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides 0-40% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate, instead of 0-20% increased Area of Effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.11.0| * The visual effects have been improved. * Now taunts all nearby enemies to attack the user, and exerts the next 5 melee attacks. Gives nearby allies a buff based on the damage of the user's weapon. * Now has a base duration of 5 seconds at gem level 1, up to 5.9 seconds at gem level 20. * Buff grants added Attack Damage equal to 3% of the damage of your main hand weapon per 5 power, up to a maximum of 20%.Counts both allies and enemies in range for power.This buff has 100% more effect on your minions. * Exerted attacks deal 5% more Damage per affected ally, up to 25%. * Now gains 1% increased Area of Effect per 1% gem quality. * Labyrinth helmet enchantments that granted 50/75% increased Rallying Cry buff effect now grant 10/15% increased Rallying Cry buff effect, and can no longer be obtained. This affects all existing items with this enchantment. * Labyrinth helmet enchantments that granted 30/45% increased Rallying Cry duration now grant 10/15% increased Rallying Cry duration, and can no longer be obtained. This affects all existing items with this enchantment. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 6 (was 8). * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 16 (was 27). }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * Added physics interactions. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Rallying Cry has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
